claims: Monitor INR closely due to recent changes in anticoagulation therapy.
Administer IV fluids to address hypotension and maintain volume status.
Administer calcium gluconate to address hypocalcemia.
Continue monitoring respiratory parameters and oxygenation.
Order a coagulation profile including PT, PTT to assess coagulation status.
Continue anticoagulation therapy with Heparin 5000 U SC as ordered.
Monitor glucose levels due to elevated blood glucose.
Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings.
Monitor intracranial pressure if not already done, given the high PaCO2.
